faq.title: Questions Before You Ask the Questions.
faq.intro: Here’s how the service works, what you can send, and where the limits are.

items.question: What can I send you?
items.answer: Plans, contractor proposals, estimates, scopes, change orders, invoices, inspection items, photographs, schedules, and relevant contractor communications. The service description tells you the file/page limits for each package.

items.question: Are you my contractor?
items.answer: No. The Construction Advice Co. provides independent construction consulting. I am not bidding your work or replacing the contractor responsible for performing it.

items.question: Is this an inspection or engineering opinion?
items.answer: No. Site observations and document reviews are advisory and based on the information available. They do not replace required inspections, engineering, architecture, code review, or legal advice.

items.question: How fast will I get a response?
items.answer: Free questions and Quick Second Opinions are designed for fast turnaround, but exact delivery depends on workload and complexity. Urgent or same-day work may require a custom quote.

items.question: Can you help if my project is already in trouble?
items.answer: Yes. The Project Rescue Review is designed for active projects dealing with delays, change orders, payment disputes, contractor communication problems, or uncertainty about what to do next.

items.question: Do you work outside Florida?
items.answer: Remote consulting may be available outside Florida for general construction guidance and document review. Local code, licensing, legal, and inspection requirements should always be confirmed by the appropriate local professional.
